generator: Remy base; local Brush texture refinement
coordinateConversion: Camera: negate X/Y to match SuperSplat SOG rendering. Voxel v1.1 is already in PlayCanvas coordinates.
calibration: 2026-10-17 core capture GS3DCedd7c150. Floor peak Y=-1.49; standing eye Y=0.06, 1.55 scan units above floor. New room/table/doorway and railing fitted to splat density and capture paths. Furniture simplified to central table; chairs and door leaves are not individual colliders.

activeCollision.basis: SOG point density, capture camera trajectory, visible doorway and browser round trip
activeCollision.limitations: Approximate walls, railing and central table; chairs and door leaves are not individual colliders.

review: 24 capture viewpoints and 32 four-direction inspection views plus 8 eye-level walk views visually reviewed; no people observed in reviewed views. Not a guarantee for every arbitrary viewpoint.

refinement.geometry: All original Gaussian means, scales, rotations and opacity restored exactly before output compression
refinement.exterior: 616304 exterior Gaussian records retained exactly before output compression
refinement.mask: Reviewed person and TV masks; enlarged before bidirectionally consistent source-pixel alignment
refinement.limitation: Moderate appearance correction; transparent glass and thin chair geometry remain imperfect. Reference comparisons are not held-out accuracy.

doorwayCleanup.method: Only losslessly reencode SOG sh0 alpha for verified empty central doorway; preserve all RGB indices, geometry, SH, and all opacity outside the volume.
doorwayCleanup.limitation: Reduces reconstructed haze inside the open doorway; does not create unobserved leaf, glass or doorframe details.
